title: Machine-learning interatomic potential predicts water adsorption in a hydrophobic MOF
summary: A machine-learning interatomic potential trained on DFT reference data, combined with molecular-dynamics transition-matrix Monte Carlo, reproduced the S-shaped water isotherm of the MOF MIP-211(Al) in excellent agreement with experimental data, including the sharp step at P/P0 of about 0.3. The simulations identify OCOO...H2O...mu-OH dual hydrogen-bond motifs in the adsorption mechanism. The study covers one MOF, the source of the experimental isotherm is not stated in the abstract and the mechanism is computational.
ai_technology: Machine-learning interatomic potential trained on DFT data with MD-based transition-matrix Monte Carlo
organization: ICGM, CNRS and ENSCM; Center for Molecular Modeling, Ghent University

evidence.tested: Comparison of the simulated isotherm with the experimental sorption isotherm for MIP-211(Al).
evidence.unknown: Source and independence of the experimental data; transfer to other MOFs; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning interatomic potential supplied DFT-level accuracy for simulating water adsorption.
